v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Supervised pilot: customer-flow fixes merged, but premium AWS skill delivery and production security still unproven

Stromation #331 skill engine merged but disabled and Fargate Chromium sandbox unresolved. #833 safe form check and #853 high-severity web auth/privacy fixes remain open. v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Five-worker bench merged, but provider-backed all-five outcomes unverified

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
